claims: Continue insulin sliding scale subcutaneous dosing for hyperglycemia management, as fingerstick glucose values have been elevated (up to 227 mg/dL).
Monitor fingerstick blood glucose every 4-6 hours to assess response to insulin therapy.
Continue nicardipine infusion at current rate (approximately 1 mcg/kg/min) for blood pressure control.
Titrate nicardipine infusion to maintain systolic blood pressure within ordered parameters (alarm high 150 mmHg).
Monitor arterial blood pressure continuously via arterial line.
Continue supplemental oxygen at 2 L/min via nasal cannula to maintain SpO2 above 92%.
Monitor oxygen saturation continuously with pulse oximetry.
Continue subcutaneous heparin 5000 units for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis.
Monitor renal function with daily basic metabolic panel (BUN, creatinine, electrolytes).
Perform daily assessment of pain level and response to analgesics (oxycodone-acetaminophen, hydromorphone as needed).
